module_summary: Synchronous 8-entry FIFO: register-array storage with wrapping read/write pointers and an occupancy counter deriving valid/ready handshakes, plus synchronous flush.

anchors.name: mem_q
anchors.why: 8x32 storage array written at wptr_q on push, read at rptr_q.

anchors.name: wptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer indexing mem_q, increments on push, cleared on flush.

anchors.name: rptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data from mem_q, increments on pop.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count; derives in_ready (not full) and out_valid (not empty), drives count_o.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Write-side valid; with in_ready forms push.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Write-side ready, asserted when FIFO not full.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Read-side valid, asserted when FIFO not empty.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Read-side ready; with out_valid forms pop.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Synchronous flush clearing pointers and count.

anchors.name: do_push
anchors.why: Push enable: writes mem_q, advances wptr_q, increments count.

anchors.name: do_pop
anchors.why: Pop enable: advances rptr_q, decrements count.

groups.name: fifo_pointers
groups.description: Read/write pointers and occupancy count with flush and push/pop enables.
